modules.name: Murder Duels Guia de Trocas
modules.description: Learn how Murder Duels trading works before exchanging valuable weapon skins and collectibles. Understand what can be traded and why rarity, demand, and limited supply matter when evaluating an offer.

highlights.detail: Unlock weapon skins and collectibles that can be exchanged with other players.
Compare the items offered by both players before accepting a trade.
Check rarity, availability, and limited-item supply before deciding whether an offer is fair.
Use the Trading Plaza to meet players and look for additional trading opportunities.

modules.name: Murder Duels Guia para Iniciantes
modules.description: Learn the fundamentals of Murder Duels from your first duel pad to winning full matches. This beginner guide covers the round objective, basic weapons, abilities, and progression systems new players encounter.

highlights.detail: Step onto a duel pad and choose a supported match format from 1v1 through 4v4.
Use both your knife and revolver during combat and learn when each weapon is most useful.
Experiment with the unique abilities available for your knife and revolver.
Win rounds consistently; the first side to reach 5 round wins takes the duel.

modules.name: Murder Duels Armas e Habilidades
modules.description: Understand the two core weapon types used in every Murder Duels match and the abilities that modify combat. Learn how knife pressure and revolver accuracy fit into the game's fast first-person dueling system.

highlights.label: Knife
highlights.detail: One of the two weapons provided in every duel, with its own set of unique abilities.

highlights.label: Revolver
highlights.detail: The ranged weapon provided alongside the knife in every duel, also supporting unique abilities.

highlights.label: Skins
highlights.detail: Unlockable cosmetic skins are available for both knife and revolver weapons and can be traded with other players.

highlights.label: Abilities
highlights.detail: Both core weapons have sets of unique abilities designed to make players stronger in combat.

modules.name: Murder Duels Modos de Jogo
modules.description: Compare every supported Murder Duels team size before entering a match. The game supports solo and team duels from 1v1 through 4v4 while keeping the same first-to-five round objective.

highlights.label: 1v1
highlights.detail: Head-to-head duel between two individual players.

highlights.label: 2v2
highlights.detail: Two-player teams compete against each other.

highlights.label: 3v3
highlights.detail: Three-player teams fight across the same round-based duel system.

highlights.label: 4v4
highlights.detail: The largest officially supported duel format, with four players on each side.

highlights.label: Sniper
highlights.detail: The first collectible and first full sniper, released with a limited stock of 1,000.

highlights.label: Ninja
highlights.detail: Limited-time bundle introduced during the Summer Event Part 1.

highlights.label: Midnight

highlights.label: Collectibles
highlights.detail: Limited drops can feature unique VFX and individually numbered serials.

modules.description: Learn the latest Murder Duels maps and customize settings that affect how combat feels. The Summer update added new arenas, reworked an existing map, and introduced additional crosshair and mobile-control customization.

highlights.label: Facility
highlights.detail: New map introduced in Summer Event Part 1.

highlights.label: House
highlights.detail: New map introduced alongside Facility in the Summer update.

highlights.label: Lumber
highlights.detail: Existing map reworked during Summer Event Part 1.

highlights.label: Crosshair
highlights.detail: Customization feature that lets players adjust their crosshair.

highlights.label: Mobile
highlights.detail: Mobile quality-of-life feature allowing players to resize control buttons.

modules.description: Track major Murder Duels updates, limited events, and newly added gameplay systems. Follow changes such as matchmaking, trading, seasonal content, maps, collectibles, and economy adjustments.

highlights.label: Trading
highlights.detail: Trading was added so players can exchange weapon skins with other players.

highlights.label: Matchmaking
highlights.detail: Global matchmaking allows players to jump into games with friends more easily.

highlights.detail: Summer Event Part 1 introduced a redesigned lobby, Facility and House maps, collectibles, bundles, and quality-of-life changes.
